newsitem.title: UK: United News raises HTV stake to 29.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: United News raises HTV stake to 29.9 pct.

text.p: Britain's United News & Media Plc said on Friday it bought 8.7 million shares in broadcaster HTV Group Plc at 420 pence per share for a total of about 36.7 million stg cash.
United said the purchase raised its stake in HTV to 26.3 million shares, or 29.9 percent of HTV's issued share capital.
United's statement confirmed market talk on Friday that the company had bought an additional 9.9 percent of HTV.
Earlier this month, United bought a 20 percent stake in HTV from Scottish Television, fuelling market speculation that it planned a full bid for HTV.
HTV's shares shot up seven percent, rising 25p to 376.5p by 1350 GMT to rank among the UK market's top percentage gainers.
In October, United said it had no plans to make an offer for HTV, an ITV broadcaster for Wales and part of western England.

Under UK takeover rules, United is prevented, in the absence of material change in circumstances, from making an offer for HTV for a period of three to 12 months from October 25. United's statement gave no further details.
